name: elvisun/newsjack
description: A PR and media monitoring tool packaged as an npm CLI plus plugin skills. The verified sample skill designs an AI visibility panel. The tool connects to a Medialyst connector over OAuth for media data.
install: npm i -g newsjack@latest. Npm route only. Do not use the README pipe installer and do not use install.sh, which downloads release tarballs and removes install directories.
